QUOTE: `LlamaCppTokenizer::detokenize` (lines 86–105) calls `llama_token_to_piece` with a 256-byte stack buffer. If that is too small, it resizes to the reported size and calls again.

WHY: The answer states detokenize tries a 256-byte stack buffer first and resizes only when too small. It also states that tokenize always probes the size first and then fills, so the contrast is covered.
